thread:
raj: heads-up: noticed a ~2.1x p95/p99 spike on the batch-router during a 30s burst. warm pool remained in steady state but we saw a bunch of cold joins and queued requests. attaching quick notes for triage.
metrics-bot: alert: latency_spike detected on /v1/completions, p99 jumped 1.8s -> 3.9s at 2134567865. affected percent: 4% 5xxs. node-gpu skew flagged on gpu-7.
maria: did the kernel selector flip during that window? last heuristics tweak was rolled 48h ago.
ethan: checked kernel-scores: rapid oscillation between aten_fused and fallback_cuda for the same shard. looks like kernel-probing triggered on noisy batch-size variance.
raj: exact log snippet from router + selector: 
```
kernel-selector: probe id=42 score=0.02 -> 0.78 timestamp=2134567865
kernel-fallback: reason=kv_miss cold_kv_fill=true eviction=true
```
yun: KV hitrate dropped from ~98% to ~61% at spike start. traces show many requests routed to newly provisioned nodes with empty KV sets (warmmap miss).
maria: autoscaler shows scale_step=4 (granularity=4). we provisioned 4 nodes in one step which left some requests landing on nodes before prefill completed. grainy scaling + aggressive kernel probing = compounding effect.
ethan: repro plan: run a synthetic burst of ~60 concurrent short requests to trigger fast kernel probing + a single-step scale. canary tomorrow if needed.
sre-oncall: this caused brief customer-visible latency and 5xxs. short-term mitigation ideas? prefer stable kernel until KV warms? route to prefilling nodes first?
raj: +1 on "stable-kernel window"—we should suppress kernel probes while kv_prefill_rate < 80% for that model. also prefer routing to nodes with warmmap_present=true when possible.
maria: immediate mitigations I'll push: 1) lower kernel_probe_threshold from 0.1 -> 0.02 for 1h toggle, 2) set autoscaler to step=1 (disable grainy burst sizing) for the cluster, 3) add prefill hook on node join: `/scripts/prefill_kv.sh --model $MODEL --timeout 20s`.
ethan: pushing kernel_probe change as a canary toggle now. if green we roll fast.
deploy-bot: deploy started by ethan for feature/kernel-probe-toggle to env=prod-canary.
ethan: canary = stable for 5m. KV hitrate returned to ~96%. p99 back down to ~1.1s. rolling to remainder of cluster.
sre-oncall: postmortem notes: action items -> runtime: tune autoscaler granularity, ensure prefill runs for every model variant on join, add `warmmap_age` and `kv_prefill_rate` metrics to the console and alerts.
raj: saving logs and plan to open RFC for kernel-selection hysteresis + smoother autoscaler (rate-limited step changes). thanks all :thumbsup:
